Subject: Co-develop demo track & hands-on webinar — Redwood x CircuitScale

Hi Jordan & Camila,

Hope your week is going well. I'm Megan — Partnerships at CircuitScale. We were impressed by Redwood's recent latency benchmarking blog and would love to propose a joint content + event push focused on developer enablement for inference at scale. High level idea: a two-part program — (1) a 60-minute hands-on webinar (live demo + short tutorial) and (2) a small demo track presence at CloudNative Connect (booth demo + 1 panel slot).

Why this makes sense: our audiences are highly overlapping (platform engineers evaluating inference stacks) and we can share promotional lift and cost. CircuitScale can handle the hands-on lab environment; Redwood would provide the integration demo and a speaker.

Possible dates: webinar week of May 10 or May 24; CloudNative Connect runs June 22–24.

If you like the idea I can share a quick agenda draft and some attendee metrics. Would you be open to a short sync next week?

Best,
Megan Li
Partnerships | CircuitScale

Thanks — attaching a short draft agenda and a booth spec for CloudNative Connect.

Draft webinar agenda (attached: draft_agenda_v1.pdf):
- 0–5m: Opening (hosts from Redwood + CircuitScale)
- 5–25m: Demo: Redwood serving runtime + CircuitScale autoscaling integration (live)
- 25–40m: Hands-on lab instructions & quick walkthrough (participants spin up a tiny env)
- 40–55m: Customer panel / Q&A
- 55–60m: CTA + resources

Estimated webinar registrants: 1.8k sign-ups, ~350 live attendees (based on similar past webinars). CloudNative demo traffic: booth footfall ~600 visitors/day; panel slot audience ~150.

Sponsorship / booth: $9k for a half-booth (includes panel slot but not premium placement). We can split promotional lift 50/50 and coordinate organic email sends.

Attachments: draft_agenda_v1.pdf; booth_spec.png

Let me know if this looks doable and whether you prefer May 12 or May 26 for the webinar — we can do either.

Best,
Megan
